CustomField.label: App Base URL
CustomField.description: Your Veleiro portal address, used for the Open in Veleiro hyperlinks (for example https://app.veleiro.ai). Set it to the same Veleiro environment your Named Credential points to. If blank, the code uses a default.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Your Veleiro portal address for the Open in Veleiro links, e.g. https://app.veleiro.ai. Use the same environment your Named Credential points to.
